realbug.writtenFrom: symptom only: upstream issue GLips/Figma-Context-MCP#364 (title, body), the fix PR's metadata (number, title, merge commit, branch name; no body, files or diff), the prefix README, .env.example, src/config.ts and the prefix server's --help and tools/list; see contract-log.md

properties.reportedPaths: content[*].text, every token that ends in .png, .svg or .gif
properties.signal: fileName or nodeId named in a text block that also says fail, error, skip, could not, unable or not (downloaded|saved|written)
properties.rule: After a non-error download_figma_images result, for every requested node n: let D = args.localPath if it is absolute, else <imageDir>/<args.localPath> (imageDir = the server's image directory, as its tool description announces it); then D/<n.fileName> (or, when n.filenameSuffix is set, a file in D whose name contains the suffix and ends with n.fileName's extension) is a regular file of size >= 1 byte. A node the response visibly reports as not downloaded (signal) is exempt. In addition, every file path the response reports (absolute, or relative to imageDir) is a regular file of size >= 1 byte. Violated otherwise. An isError result is unverifiable (an explicit error is a signal the agent sees).
